title: Claude Code
description: Usage, cost, tokens, code changes and tool activity reported by Claude Code agents.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Applies to cost, tokens, lines of code and API panels

panels.title: Sessions

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_session_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Claude Code sessions started.

panels.title: Users

targets.expr: count(count by (user_email) (last_over_time(claude_code_session_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct Claude Code accounts that started a session.

panels.title: Total Cost

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Estimated API cost reported by Claude Code.

panels.title: Total Tokens

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Input, output, cache read and cache creation tokens.

panels.title: Commits

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_commit_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Git commits created by Claude Code.

panels.title: Pull Requests

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_pull_request_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Pull requests created by Claude Code.

panels.title: Lines Added

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Lines of code added by Claude Code edits.

panels.title: Lines Removed

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="removed", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Lines of code removed by Claude Code edits.

panels.title: Active Time

targets.expr: sum by (type) (increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Time actively spent: cli = Claude Code working, user = you interacting.

panels.title: Tokens by Type

targets.expr: sum by (type) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Token totals per type.

panels.title: Tool Decisions

targets.expr: sum by (decision) (increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Edit / Write / NotebookEdit permission decisions: accept or reject.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)) / sum (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type=~"input|cacheRead|cacheCreation", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Share of input-side tokens served from the prompt cache: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheCreation). Higher is cheaper.

panels.title: Top Users by Cost

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (user_email) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))))

panels.description: Top 10 accounts by cost.

panels.title: Top Users by Tokens

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (user_email) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))))

panels.description: Top 10 accounts by tokens.

panels.title: Top Sessions by Cost

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (session_id, host_name) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))))

panels.description: Top 10 sessions by cost. Search the session id in the Loki panels below for its events.

panels.title: Cost by Model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Share of cost per model.

panels.title: Edit Decisions by Language

targets.expr: sum by (language) (increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Edit-tool calls per file language.

panels.title: Sessions by Terminal

targets.expr: sum by (terminal_type) (increase(claude_code_session_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range] anchored))

panels.description: Where Claude Code ran: terminal emulator, IDE or non-interactive.

panels.title: Usage by VM and user

targets.expr: sum by (host_name, user_email) (increase(claude_code_session_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range] anchored))
sum by (host_name, user_email) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))
sum by (host_name, user_email) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))
sum by (host_name, user_email) (increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__range] anchored))

sum by (host_name, user_email) (increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored))

(max by (host_name, user_email) (timestamp({__name__=~"claude_code_(session_count|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"})) or max by (host_name, user_email) (max_over_time(timestamp({__name__=~"claude_code_(session_count|active_time_seconds|cost_usage_USD)_total", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"})[$__range:5m]))) * 1000

panels.description: One row per VM and account. Click a column header to sort.

panels.title: Cost Over Time

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Cost per hour. Legend total = cost in the whole-hour buckets shown.

panels.title: Cost by Model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Cost per hour, stacked by model.

panels.title: Token Usage by Type

targets.expr: sum by (type) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Tokens per hour, stacked by type.

panels.title: Token Usage by Model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Tokens per hour, stacked by model.

panels.title: Cost by query_source

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (query_source) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "query_source", "none", "query_source", "")

panels.description: main = your conversation, subagent = Task agents, auxiliary = background calls, sdk = claude -p / Agent SDK.

panels.title: Cost by effort

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (effort) (increase(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__range] anchored)), "effort", "none", "effort", "")

panels.description: Cost per reasoning-effort level. none = model without an effort setting.

panels.title: Active Time (per hour)

targets.expr: sum by (type) (increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Active seconds per hour: cli = Claude Code working, user = you interacting.

panels.title: Lines of Code (per hour)

targets.expr: sum (increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="added", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

sum (increase(claude_code_lines_of_code_count_total{type="removed", host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env", model=~"$model"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Added lines above the axis, removed lines below.

panels.title: Tool Decisions Over Time

targets.expr: sum by (decision) (increase(claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: Edit-tool permission decisions per hour.

panels.title: Sessions by VM (per hour)

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) (increase(claude_code_session_count_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: New sessions per hour, stacked by VM.

panels.title: When each VM was active

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) (increase(claude_code_active_time_seconds_total{host_name=~"$host", user_email=~"$user", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval)) > 0

panels.description: Green where the VM reported active time in that 5-minute bucket (or wider on long ranges).

panels.title: API requests by model

targets.expr: sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))

panels.description: Model API calls per time bucket.

panels.title: API latency p50 / p95

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (model)

quantile_over_time(0.50, {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_request" | user_email=~"$user" | model=~"$model" | unwrap duration_ms [$__auto] offset -$__auto) by (model)

panels.description: Duration of each API request, including streaming the response.

panels.title: Tool calls by tool

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])))

panels.description: Tool executions over the time range.

panels.title: Tool success rate

targets.expr: (sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | success="true" [$__range])) or sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range])) * 0) / sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" [$__range]))

panels.description: Share of tool executions that succeeded.

panels.title: Prompts by VM

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="user_prompt" | user_email=~"$user" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))

panels.description: User prompts per time bucket.

panels.title: API errors by status code

targets.expr: sum by (status_code) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name="api_error" | user_email=~"$user" [$__auto] offset -$__auto))

panels.description: Failed API requests per time bucket.

panels.title: Errors and failed tool calls

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", host_name=~"$host", deployment_environment_name=~"$env"} | event_name=~"api_error|tool_result" | user_email=~"$user" | success!="true" | line_format `{{.host_name}}  {{.event_name}}  {{.tool_name}}{{.model}}  {{.status_code}} {{.error_type}} {{.error}}`

defaults.noValue: No errors or failed tool calls

panels.description: Newest first. Click a line for all its fields (session_id, tool_name, error, ...).

panels.title: Recent interactions
panels.description: One trace per prompt (beta tracing); follows the VM, User and Environment filters. Click a trace id to open it.

panels.title: Interaction duration

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service="claude-code", span_name="claude_code.interaction"}[$__interval] anchored offset -$__interval))

panels.description: How long prompts took end to end (Tempo span metrics). Cell colour = number of prompts in that duration bucket; see the scale below.

panels.title: Accepted by the collector

targets.expr: sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Data received from agents.

panels.title: Export queue size

targets.expr: sum by (exporter) (otelcol_exporter_queue_size)

panels.description: Data waiting for a backend. Grows while a backend is down, then drains to 0.

panels.title: Dropped or refused

targets.expr: sum by (exporter) (rate(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (exporter) (rate(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (exporter) (rate(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (exporter) (rate(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (exporter) (rate(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (exporter) (rate(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (receiver) (rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (receiver) (rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (receiver) (rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_spans[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Empty is good.
